placeholders.why: Opens the Swift 2 product gallery (ProductMedia, ProductMediaGallery) in PhotoSwipe 5 instead of the stock Bootstrap modal: full screen, counter, swipe, pinch, double-tap, wheel and button zoom to 4x, pan, and an open-original button. It reads the slide list from the stock modal carousel, so no Swift template is forked; when it or PhotoSwipe fails to load, the stock modal opens as before. Registered by theme-default's add-on slot (2.6.0 or later).

Gallery presentation for mixed image sizes: a scheme-derived tint behind the letterboxed main image, square cover-fitted thumbnails, and a zoom-in cursor. Scoped to the gallery item class. Registered after default_custom.css and before brand.css, so a brand rule still wins.

costHints.note: Opt-in: compose it only for image-heavy demos. Needs theme-default 2.6.0 or later, whose DefaultHeadInclude.cshtml registers Custom/Addons/<name>/addon.css and addon.js for every add-on folder on disk; on an older theme the files are delivered and never loaded, which the first behaviorProbe catches. The layer.schema.json has no formal 'depends' field; the dependency is advisory. Files only: no fragmentModes, no customCode (front-end assets, no C#). Browser proof of the zoom is the Foundry GALLERY-ZOOM design probe on the PDP, which reports N/A on editions that do not compose this layer.
costHints.vendored: PhotoSwipe 5.4.4 (MIT, photoswipe/LICENSE.txt), dist/*.esm.min.js and photoswipe.css unmodified from the npm package. About 4 KB gzip loads with every page (addon.js 3 KB, addon.css 1 KB); the lightbox (4.5 KB), the core (16.4 KB) and the sheet (2.4 KB) load on the first open.
